decisions.reason: As an adjustable quarter-pallet display close to the core cardboard range, it still offers some option value at low carrying cost, though after several years its prospects should be clearer and weaker than at launch.

Because this pegboard-back variant is more niche and has not remained visibly prominent, the information gained since launch likely reduces its option value enough to justify reallocating capacity to stronger core and new projects.
This quarter-pallet concept overlaps heavily with other established display options, so after multiple years the firm would likely close this now-redundant option and focus resources elsewhere.
The eighth-pallet format adds a distinct size within the familiar display family and is inexpensive for a large integrated producer to keep available while serving varied retail needs.
